original.statement: The Helm options hubble.tls.server.cert, hubble.tls.server.key, hubble.relay.tls.client.cert, hubble.relay.tls.client.key, hubble.relay.tls.server.cert, hubble.relay.tls.server.key, hubble.ui.tls.client.cert, and hubble.ui.tls.client.key are deprecated in favor of the associated existingSecret options and will be removed in a future release.

corrected.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the Helm option hubble.tls.server.cert is deprecated in favor of the associated existingSecret option and will be removed in a future release.

decision.reason: [ev-672c6336b39c] says directly that the Helm option `hubble.tls.server.cert` is deprecated and will be removed in a future release, so the subject and the "deprecated" type are right. It is one of eight keys deprecated in the same sentence, and assessing it as a single key is a valid split. However, the evidence only refers to "the associated `existingSecret` options" and never spells out the path `hubble.tls.server.existingSecret`. No validator or artifact confirms that path either. replacedBy is optional, so I dropped it instead of guessing a name the text does not give.
